name: prompt-tree-of-thoughts
description: Use when the user asks about Tree of Thoughts (ToT), BFS/DFS or beam search over reasoning paths, backtracking, or using an LLM to score partial solutions. Produces a ToT config and implementation with call budget and a comparison against CoT and self-consistency. Not for single-path reasoning (use prompt-chain-of-thought) or agent debate (use swarm-architectures).
